title: annona nutans
intro: Annona nutans, commonly known as the Custard Apple or Wild Custard Apple, is a tropical plant species belonging to the Annonaceae family. It is a small to medium-sized tree with a wide distribution in the tropical and subtropical regions of the world. The health benefits of Annona nutans include its potential to act as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant agent, which can help in the management of various diseases such as diabetes, hypertension, and cancer. The bioactive constituents of Annona nutans include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-cancer, anti-inflammatory, and anti-diabetic properties.
